rules.note: Verbatim: 'Twelve weeks of ADPL is authorized during the 1-year period beginning after the child's date of birth.' The same 12 weeks is stated at 3.11.c.(3)(b) for the non-birth parent, 3.11.c.(4) for adoption or adoption placement, and 3.11.c.(5) for long-term foster care placement, each during a 1-year period. Change 1 adds a 2-year period for a qualifying circumstance under 3.11.c.(11) with first GO/FO approval; that is an extension, not a change to the 12-week maximum.

Reserve Component inactive duty parental leave. Verbatim at 3.11.d.(3)(a): 'Birth parent, 12 IDPL periods will be authorized during the 1-year period'. An IDPL period is defined at 3.11.d.(1)(c): 'IDPL will be taken in increments equivalent to a 4-hour inactive duty training period of which a maximum of two such increments may be taken per day. Each such 4-hour increment constitutes an IDPL period.' Twelve periods is therefore 48 hours, NOT 12 weeks. Deliberately carries no concept: it is a different entitlement for a different population in a unit the conversion table cannot and should not bridge.
Verbatim: 'Service members choosing to take ADPL in multiple increments must request such proposed leave in blocks of at least 7 days each for a maximum of 12 increments...'
Same sentence as ADPL_MIN_INCREMENT_DAYS: '...blocks of at least 7 days each for a maximum of 12 increments'.

Verbatim: 'Multiple qualifying events occurring within the same 72-hour period will be treated as a single event for the allocation of ADPL.' Para 3.11.c.(6)(a) states the converse for events outside that period.

Verbatim: 'ADPL that is not taken before the expiration of 1 year from the date of a child's birth, minor child's adoption by the Service member, or minor child's placement with the Service member for adoption or long-term foster care will be forfeited, unless Paragraph 3.11.c.(11) applies.' The issuance states ONE YEAR, not a day count. Recorded in the unit the source uses. The corpus records the Marine Corps side as 365 days, which is an inference rather than a quotation - see verification/findings-forfeiture-window.md.

corrections.against: DoWI 1327.06, August 7, 2025, incorporating Change 1, June 30, 2026, read in full (75 pages).
changes: Source edition corrected. The record carried 'Effective August 7, 2025' only. Change 1, effective June 30, 2026, exists and is now recorded.
Originator corrected from OUSD(P&R) to Office of the Under Secretary of War for Personnel and Readiness, per the issuance cover page.

CURRENT_DOD_PARENTAL_LEAVE_WEEKS citation corrected from 3.11.c to 3.11.c.(3)(a)1. Paragraph 3.11.c is the ADPL heading and states no value. The 12-week figure is stated at 3.11.c.(3)(a) and (3)(a)1 for the birth parent, (3)(b) for the non-birth parent, (4) for adoption, and (5) for long-term foster care.
Rule renamed ADPL_MAX_WEEKS. The prior id said DOD and CURRENT, neither of which is a property of the value.
Added IDPL_MAX_PERIODS at 12 periods, with the 4-hour definition at 3.11.d.(1)(c). It carries NO concept: an IDPL period is not a week and comparing it to ADPL would be a category error.
Status stays UNVERIFIED. A machine read this PDF; no human has confirmed it. Promotion is a human act recorded in verification/attestations.jsonl.
Added source.url, source.url_basis, and source.artifact with the SHA-256 of the PDF read.

Recorded both editions. The locally held 132706p.pdf (sha256 7cdeb5bc..., 77 pages) is the BASE August 7, 2025 edition approved by USD(P&R) Anthony J. Tata, styled DoD Instruction. The edition read for this entry (sha256 1718797f..., 76 pages) carries Change 1 of June 30, 2026, is styled DoW Instruction, and was approved by Deputy Under Secretary of War Sean O'Keefe. Confirmed identical across both editions: the 12-week ADPL figure and its wording at 3.11.c.(3)(a)1, the 4-hour IDPL period definition at 3.11.d.(1)(c), the 12 IDPL periods at 3.11.d.(3)(a), and the DTM 23-001 cancellation at 1.3.a.(2). Present ONLY in Change 1: the 2-year ADPL window. Wording differs at 3.11.d.(3)(a): base reads 'For the birth parent', Change 1 reads 'Birth parent'.

Added four DoD-tier counterparts read from the same PDF: ADPL_MIN_INCREMENT_DAYS (3.11.c.(7)(a)), ADPL_MAX_INCREMENTS (3.11.c.(7)(a)), ADPL_EVENT_MERGE_HOURS (3.11.c.(6)(b)), and ADPL_FORFEITURE_WINDOW_YEARS (3.11.c.(10)(c)). All UNVERIFIED; a machine read them.
